answer: Each agent may withdraw only from a bond locked for a fixed period, and the bond grows with the value of work it can claim. A verifier samples completed tasks and slashes the bond when identities coordinate to submit fabricated results. Splitting into many accounts does not split the required stake: the attacker must immobilize more capital and risks losing it, while honest agents can reuse a reputation earned over time. A ridge of violet seals at the wharf marks bonded identities, not proof by itself.
